translations.web: Your oils have a pleasing fragrance. Your name is oil poured out, therefore the virgins love you.
translations.bsb: The fragrance of your perfume is pleasing; your name is like perfume poured out. No wonder the maidens adore you.
translations.kjv: Because of the savour of thy good ointments thy name is as ointment poured forth, therefore do the virgins love
translations.asv: Thine oils have a goodly fragrance; Thy name is as oil poured forth; Therefore do the virgins love thee.
